purpose: Apply the already-frozen V29R3 rule without modification to the latest complete local evidence and publish annual signal and completed-trade statistics without replacing any prior artifact.

fixed_rule.parent: V27 M20/F14/R5 prior-high reversal with next legal one-minute entry, A67 target, H20 time stop and no failure stop
fixed_rule.v28: At the completed signal close require registered CY-033 hard_valid, known non-ST state, and at most one one-price limit-down in the 20 completed sessions strictly before the signal.
fixed_rule.v28r1: Raw signal close must be strictly below registered signal-day up-limit price minus 0.006 CNY.
fixed_rule.v28r2: Raw signal-day amount must be positive and no more than 2.0 times the positive median raw amount of exactly 20 completed trading sessions strictly before the signal; every source row must be hard-valid, snapshot-bound and available by the signal decision.
fixed_rule.v29r3: Raw signal-day stock return minus the unweighted median return of all eligible rows physically present in the same registered CY-033 partition must be no more than 0.02, inclusively.
fixed_rule.portfolio: Main and ChiNext 50/50 sleeves; K80 per sleeve; same-symbol overlap and capacity rules unchanged.

rollforward_scope.2025: Complete signal-year diagnostic sourced from the simultaneously frozen V27 2024-2025 diagnostic; maximum source exit is 2025-12-09.
rollforward_scope.2026: Mature YTD diagnostic only. Data end is 2026-09-04 and only V27 signals formed no later than the frozen maturity cutoff 2026-08-03 are eligible; later signals are right-censored and are not counted as zero-return trades.

input_governance.cross_section_limitation: Conditional observed-row cross-section only. Historical security-master completeness and survivorship freedom are not proven because QD-007 is not materialized.
